chunk_map.heading: An agent widens in minutes; the choosing stays with you

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: line 4: "it goes better when widening and choosing stay apart" is the closest pronoun; "it" is the clause subject whose referent is the choosing just named, and "them" resolves to "a list of opportunities, or of rough solutions" in the prior sentence. Harm (unresolvable referent on a projected slide) absent.
grep -nE "opening lecture|earlier lecture|previous (slide|lecture)|the (first|last) (lecture|module)" on body → 0; line 4 points at no other file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: line 4 has no "the X you did/saw/caught" construction; no backward reference to a beat. Closest: "Choosing between them" (in-sentence antecedent).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no live-demo, guess-before-reveal or screen-pointing beat

rules_evaluated.evidence: line 4 carries a full self-standing claim: widening is cheap, choosing is yours, keep them apart or the first plausible option wins; not a wait-state.
header line 1 "An agent widens in minutes; the choosing stays with you" is borne out by line 4 sentences 1-2; no contradiction.

line 4 closest: "Choose while the list is still growing, and the first plausible option tends to win." One declarative, no Not-X-Not-Y, no triple, no superlative, no number+retraction, no abstraction stack (widening/choosing are plain verbs), no verb triplet.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -niE "surface|firing|compendium|forcing function|beat|mood|Connections" on body lines 1-5 → 0 hits; "widening"/"choosing" are ordinary words.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -c "\*\*" on body lines 1-5 → 0 bolded elements, inside the budget.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: single slide file, no layout/wrapper change; slide-file inclusion is the host deck's concern and this edit touches no renderer path

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-numbering.js → "OK — 55 files, Phase/Step numbering consistent."; header carries no hand-numbering.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js → "OK — 55 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut."; grep below|above on body → 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/slides/diverge-then-converge.md → "oversized: 0", 1 slide, limits 210 words / 6 bullets (body about 55 words, 0 bullets).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: line 1 "An agent widens in minutes; the choosing stays with you" is a claim-form heading, correct for a lecture slide; no instructing header.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: line 4: sentence 1 and the first half of sentence 2 restate header line 1, but the slide has no bullets, and sentence 2 second half plus sentence 3 add the keep-apart stance and its reason; not a kicker, not design commentary. Closest to class (a); stays inside because the restated half is the slide lede, not a repeated recitation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: new slide file rebuilt whole; no header rename over an inherited body (maintainer STATUS records a rebuild, not a retitle)
